```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(ranger)
library(finetune)

```



```{r}
training_metadata <- read_csv("../data/training/training_meta.csv")

training_soil <- read_csv("../data/training/training_soil.csv")

training_trait <- read_csv("../data/training/training_trait.csv")

training_metadata
training_soil
training_trait

```



```{r}

training_soil1 <- training_soil %>%

separate(site,
                   into = c("site", "year_"))

```




```{r}
data_combined <- training_trait %>%
  left_join(training_soil1, by = c("site", "year")) %>%
  left_join(training_metadata_summary, by = c("site", "year"))
write_csv(data_combined,"../final_project/chat/merged_data.csv")

```

```{r}

data_combined %>%
  count(site, year) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

```


```{r}
nrow(training_trait)
nrow(data_combined)

training_metadata %>% count(site, year) %>% filter(n > 1)

training_metadata_summary %>% count(site, year) %>% filter(n > 1)


training_soil %>% count(site, year) %>% filter(n > 1)



training_metadata_summary <- training_metadata %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```



```{r}
trait_counts <- training_trait %>% count(site, year)

merged_counts <- data_combined %>% count(site, year)


comparison <- trait_counts %>%
  left_join(merged_counts, by = c("site", "year"), suffix = c("_before", "_after"))

comparison %>% filter(n_after > n_before)
```


```{r}

trait_counts %>% filter(site == "MOH1", year == 2018)

data_combined %>% filter(site == "MOH1", year == 2018)
data_combined %>% filter(site == "MOH1", year == 2020)

```
